description:
Verify the live ConsentEase installation on a site's homepage, like a first-time visitor who has not clicked the banner. Run it after placing the snippet from consentease_setup_site and publishing the website. Takes up to ~25 seconds.

Args:
  - id (string): The site id (siteId from consentease_setup_site).

Checks (20 points each, setupScore 0–100):
  - snippet_in_head: the ConsentEase script for this site is in <head>.
  - snippet_before_gtm: Consent Mode defaults are set before Google Tag Manager / gtag.
  - consent_mode_defaults: all 7 Google Consent Mode v2 defaults are set (6 denied, security_storage granted).
  - script_loads: the ConsentEase script returns HTTP 200.
  - no_trackers_before_consent: no tracking cookies, tracker scripts or Google measurement without denied consent before any choice.

Returns JSON: { siteId, domain, checkedUrl, status: "complete"|"partial"|"unreachable", reason, setupScore, checks: [{ id, passed, detail }], openItems: string[], checkedAt, note }. A check that could not be measured is passed=false with a "Not measured" detail. Fix the openItems, then run the check again.

IMPORTANT: this is a technical setup check of one page visit. It is NOT a legal assessment and NOT proof of GDPR/ePrivacy compliance — never present it as one. Limits: one running check per user, 30 per user per day. Requires scope: sites:read.
name: consentease_check_installation
title: Check a site's ConsentEase installation
